cues: Most of these methods give a mixture: partially polarized light.
To measure how polarized it is, look through an analyser and rotate it a full turn.
The brightness swings between a maximum and a minimum.
The degree of polarization is I max minus I min, over I max plus I min.
It is one for fully polarized light, and zero for unpolarized light.
